name: Arizona Assured and Adequate Water Supply Programs
update_frequency: Irregular, with program materials and provider lists updated separately
known_limitations: The program describes water-supply review criteria and designated-provider context, but it does not by itself prove facility-level industrial water demand, reuse capacity, discharge permits, provider obligations, or drought resilience for a specific semiconductor site.
notes: Official ADWR program page for assured and adequate water supply criteria, including 100-year water supply evaluation concepts relevant to Arizona growth and local-system constraint analysis. Phase 35 check confirmed physical, continuous, legal, water-quality, financial, and management-plan criteria remain useful but not facility-specific.
